definitions.explanation: A tool with two legs used for drawing circles and arcs.

examples.english: To draw a circle with a compass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧コンパス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: To use a compass in math class.

examples.japanese: コンパス⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{定規|じょうぎ}→定規：04280_jougi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧あれ⟦ば→ば：noentry⟧、⟦いろいろ→いろいろ：02352_iroiro⟧な⟦{図形|ずけい}→図形：04036_zukei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{描|か}ける→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: With a compass and ruler, you can draw various shapes.

examples.japanese: コンパス⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{方角|ほうがく}→方角：08447_hougaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: To check the direction with a compass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧コンパス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たよ}り→頼り：14634_tayori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The ship navigates by relying on the compass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}った→迷う：02426_mayou⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧、コンパス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}った→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧。
examples.english: When I got lost in the mountains, the compass came in handy.

notes:
コンパス has two meanings in Japanese: the geometry drawing tool (primary meaning) and the navigation compass.

ALTERNATIVE TERMS:
- ⟦{方位|ほうい}→方位：13047_houi⟧⟦{磁石|じしゃく}→磁石：04211_jishaku⟧: navigation compass (direction magnet)
- ⟦{羅針盤|らしんばん}→羅針盤：23006_rashinban⟧: compass (nautical, formal)

SCHOOL SUPPLIES:
コンパス is a common item needed for geometry classes in Japanese schools, along with ⟦{定規|じょうぎ}→定規：04280_jougi⟧ (ruler) and ⟦{分度器|ぶんどき}→分度器：05596_bundoki⟧ (protractor).

- コンパス⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧: to draw a circle with a compass
- コンパス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a compass
